card.title: IPhone 5 "FindFlashMediaAndKeepout" error while booting repair

claims.statement: The iPhone 5 FindFlashMediaAndKeepout boot error (and 4013 on restore) is mostly from liquid damage or bad flex connections; unplugging cameras, flash, proximity flex or the display can let it boot/restore.
If that fails, removing compass IC U15 (by the front camera connector) often allows boot; compass and rotation are lost until it's replaced.

procedure: Unplug flexes one by one and retry.
Remove compass IC U15; test boot.
Fit a new U15 to restore compass.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
